object_description: orthogonal campus of varied volumes around a central esplanade
design_condition: The new volumes extend the existing development pattern around a common center, with an esplanade following the slope and a low gymnasium partly recessed into the terrain to connect naturally to the sports facilities.

positive.statement: The rectangular building volumes create attractive spaces that open to the neighborhood and connect the school complex with the district.

position.rationale: Multiple orthogonal volumes and intervening gaps are clearly visible across the model.

positive.statement: The independent orthogonal pattern establishes a common center and a precise formal and structural relationship between the parts.

position.rationale: Central open area is constrained between the distributed volumes and low access-level surfaces.

positive.statement: The floor staggering of the existing building is elegantly incorporated into the access typology.

position.rationale: Stepped and vertically differentiated volumes visibly register changing floor levels.

positive.statement: The central skylight illuminates the lightweight building and accentuates the roof area visible from the esplanade.

position.rationale: A likely roof-level feature is placed over the central campus region, though no skylight is distinct.

positive.statement: The open-plan access floor skilfully combines entrance, foyer, gallery and auditorium into an attractive group of public spaces.

position.rationale: Low western and central masses plausibly contain the access-level public sequence.

positive.statement: The kindergarten proposal offers a child-friendly building structure with varied teaching methods and play options.

position.rationale: A smaller independent volume is positioned within the varied-height ensemble.

positive.statement: The spatial integration of the kindergarten works, and later conversion of its rooms into workrooms seems possible.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are approximated within the smaller kindergarten-scale volume.

positive.statement: The new school draws its identity from a carefully implemented campus idea and develops practical use groupings within clear building structures.

position.rationale: The complete multi-volume campus and its practical groupings are visible across all calibrated views.

negative.statement: The tree grove is not yet positioned in a sufficiently powerful and spatially precise manner relative to the building volume.

position.rationale: A landscape zone is approximated beside the eastern building edge; vegetation is absent from the sample.

negative.statement: The open-space approach with extensive green cover remains tentative in its formulation.

position.rationale: The broad open-space area is placed in the interstitial campus zone without visible landscape points.

negative.statement: The height difference between the school buildings and gymnasium obscures the obviousness of the access solution.

position.rationale: The compact low mass contrasts visibly with taller adjacent volumes.

negative.statement: The requirements for protection, rescue and obstacle-free passage remain insufficient.

position.rationale: Access circulation is approximated along the lower campus edge; safety systems are not represented.

negative.statement: The positioning and topographical embedding of the grass playing field are not convincing and require major earth movements.

position.rationale: The field is placed in a peripheral open zone, but terrain and grass are not sampled.

negative.statement: The barrier-free access at street level is unfortunate and highlights the general accessibility problem caused by the staggered floors.

position.rationale: Street-facing access is approximated along the southern edge at the lowest visible level.

negative.statement: The location of the textile-work rooms disrupts the desired spatial relationships within a teaching unit.

position.rationale: Interior teaching rooms are approximated within the eastern classroom volume.

negative.statement: The route from the gym entrance to the cloakrooms and sports rooms uses a somewhat awkward staircase.

position.target: gym entrance to cloakrooms and sports rooms
position.rationale: The gym access zone is placed at the lower edge of the compact sports-related volume.

negative.statement: The reduced entrance hall, combined with mixed age groups, seems cramped.

position.rationale: The entrance hall is approximated in the compressed lower access zone.

negative.statement: The common center cannot match the intended generosity, and proximity between buildings creates a spatial bottleneck along the esplanade.

position.rationale: The central interstitial corridor visibly narrows between closely spaced building masses.

negative.statement: The carefully worked-out proposal still shows small weaknesses in terms of phasing.

position.rationale: Phasing is an operational judgment without a specific geometric marker.
